messages.subject: Re: [dartR] Error message
parts:
Hi Swati,
Are you following workflows as outlined in these tutorials? http://georges.biomatix.org/dartR
Unless something has changed those utils functions are used internally by dartR and not called by the user.
DartR works with genlight objects so I am not sure what you mean by a dartR object. Perhaps you could expand on what your original data source/format was.
Cheers,
Olly

From: da...@googlegroups.com <da...@googlegroups.com> on behalf of Swati Puranik <swatip...@gmail.com>

To: dartR <da...@googlegroups.com>
Subject: [dartR] Error message
 
Hello,

I am using dartR v 2.7.2 and trying to convert my dartR object generating after filtering to a genlight object. When I am trying to use the following code 
> utils.dart2genlight(gl7, ind.metafile = "Metadata_test.csv", verbose = NULL) 

I receive the error message
Error in utils.dart2genlight(gl7, ind.metafile = "Metadata_test.csv", : could not find function "utils.dart2genlight"

P.S. > gl7 
******************** *** DARTR OBJECT *** ******************** ** 
79 genotypes, 8,454 SNPs , size: 33.2 Mb

What I am doing wrong?

Thank you.

best regards
Swati

messages.subject: Re: [dartR] Error message
parts:
Hi Swati,

to convert a dartR in a genlight object simply say

class(gl7) <- "genlight "

Cheers, Bernd

no need to use the utils functions 

Cheers, Bernd

messages.subject: Re: [dartR] Error message
parts: Thank you Prof. Gruber, it worked!

79 genotypes, 8,454 SNPs , size: 33.2 Mb missing data: 26282 (=3.94 %) scored as NA
> gl8 <- gl7
> class(gl8) <- "genlight"
> gl8 
/// GENLIGHT OBJECT ///////// // 
79 genotypes, 8,454 binary SNPs, size: 33.2 Mb 26282 (3.94 %) missing data


Best regards
Swati
